summary: Initial Morgan research queue for converting elite market practice and current strategy observations into Stock Ultimus hypotheses.

hypotheses.observed_practice: Short put candidates require bullish or constructive technical context, executable put data, acceptable DTE/delta, manageable spread, and assignment-aware risk review.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Naked Put readiness quality improves when technical fit, option quality, account risk, event risk, and CANSLIM/fundamental filters are scored separately and all blockers remain explicit.
hypotheses.blocked_from_entry_ready_until: Already covered by V30/V31 gates; ranking implementation still pending.

hypotheses.observed_practice: Cash-secured put selling should be treated more strictly than margin-supported put selling because assignment cash must be reserved.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Cash Secured Put can share Naked Put technical and option-quality gates, but ENTRY_READY must require explicit assignment cash availability and reserve accounting.

hypotheses.observed_practice: Defined-risk neutral option income strategies depend on range confirmation, volatility context, four executable legs, net credit, max risk, and exit/invalidation planning.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Iron Condor should remain RADAR_ONLY until multi-leg schema, volatility regime checks, and explicit max-risk/exit-plan gates are canonical.

hypotheses.observed_practice: 0DTE index options are a major current market practice, but they require strict intraday risk limits, event awareness, liquidity controls, and fast invalidation.
hypotheses.hypothesis: 0DTE strategies should stay research-only until Stock Ultimus has intraday max-loss governance, event-window blockers, defined-risk-only structures, and outcome tracking at intraday resolution.
